title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: The new command wrote at offsets it had not checked, and the guard that fixed it introduced a worse one in the cascade.

highlights.title: Offsets checked before the cut
highlights.description: The corpus snapshot lives for a minute and its staleness test only looks at dirty documents. A file open and clean but reloaded underneath passed it with different content, and the cuts aimed at the wrong lines.

highlights.title: The cascade is only ever told the truth
highlights.description: It was planned on every cut while only some were sent, so it removed the import of a symbol that had stayed. It takes the caller at its word and verifies nothing, so the files that moved are dropped before the plan is made.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Remove Everything Unused checks that a file is still what it measured before cutting it, and leaves the others alone.
The cascade is planned only on the cuts that will actually be sent.
The loop says so when it stops with work still left, instead of reading as finished.
In review mode the report says what was sent to the preview, not what was removed, because what a reader ticks never comes back to the command.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Three of the four were introduced in the hour before, two of them by the fix for the first one.
